title: (Associate) Director, Program Innovation & Evidence, The AI Access Initiative
description: About The AI Access Initiative (2AI)We're at an inflection point in artificial intelligence – presenting both tremendous potential opportunity and risk for people in developing countries.

raw.title: (Associate) Director, Program Innovation & Evidence, The AI Access Initiative
raw.excerpt: About The AI Access Initiative (2AI)We're at an inflection point in artificial intelligence – presenting both tremendous potential opportunity and risk for people in developing countries.
raw.description:
About The AI Access Initiative (2AI)

We're at an inflection point in artificial intelligence – presenting both tremendous potential opportunity and risk for people in developing countries. AI capabilities are improving on a timescale measured in months, while development systems often move on timescales measured in decades. Much of the technology needed for positive impact exists today, but few organizations exist to bridge research, deployment, and scaled implementation: we must act now to ensure AI's benefits reach people in poverty in LMICs.

Incubated at Evidence Action, we're scaling The AI Access Initiative, an organization focused on scaling AI-enabled 'big bets' to benefit tens or hundreds of millions of people in poverty in low- and middle-income countries (LMICs). We operate at the intersection of global development actors, top AI labs, and leading researchers to drive meaningful access to AI's benefits for the 3.5 billion people living in poverty globally. We create "public good," open-sourced playbooks, toolkits, and insights that define how to design and launch tractable and impactful AI-enabled programs. Given the scale of opportunity, we expect our portfolio to expand substantially, but to start, we're scaling two programs focused on AI in Agriculture and AI in Health.

We are led by former Evidence Action CEO Kanika Bahl, a founding member of Anthropic's Long-Term Benefit Trust, and advised by Nobel Laureate Michael Kremer; Dario Amodei, CEO of Anthropic; and Kent Walker, President, Global Affairs for Alphabet and Google. This work builds on Evidence Action's track record reaching 530M+ people with cost-effective, evidence-based programs across 9 countries in Africa and Asia, with a focus on last-mile delivery.

The Role

2AI is building fast. We have a founding team, two live program portfolios, and a pipeline of opportunities that will drive significant expansion. The programs we are running have credible pathways to 100s of millions of people. While incubated at Evidence Action, we plan to spin out in Q4 ‘26.

Our Agriculture portfolio is scaling AI-enabled weather forecasting services to reach tens of millions of smallholder farmers, in close partnership with state and national governments in India and soon other low-and-middle income countries. We are seeking a rigorous, high-ownership Associate Director or Director, Program Innovation & Evidence to own the engine behind this work: testing and improving how forecasts are formatted, framed, and delivered; developing new forecast types in partnership with leading academics; and building the cost-effectiveness evidence base that determines what we scale.

This role reports into the VP, Agriculture and includes people leadership, managing at least one senior manager across the program.

You Will:

  • Own forecast message testing: Run A/B tests across format, framing, and delivery mechanism to best practices for what drives farmer comprehension and behavior change.
  • Scope and pilot new forecast delivery channels: Identify and test emerging distribution channels for forecasts, such as chatbots, WhatsApp, SMS, social media, etc., assessing reach, cost, and effectiveness against existing channels.
  • Oversee development of novel forecasts: Partner with academics to develop high-impact forecasts of new types, managing a roadmap for how new forecasts are prioritized, developed, and benchmarked. This could include hiring and managing post-doctoral students to support in model benchmarking or dataset support.
  • Support monitoring and evaluation (M&E): Coordinate with in-country teams to implement M&E and identify concrete ways to improve programs based on the insights.
  • Lead cost-effectiveness analysis: Develop and update cost-effectiveness (CE) analyses for our agriculture programs, and stay abreast of the emerging evidence base.
  • Scope other agriculture innovations: Assess new directions for the portfolio, including benchmarking, advisory services, and entirely new intervention types.
  • Partner with stakeholders: Create new and nurture existing relationships with academic institutions, research groups, delivery partners, and other agriculture organizations.
  • Develop best practices and thought leadership: Across all of the above, build best practices and replicable toolkits that can be applied elsewhere by others. Share key learnings with the sector through toolkits, blogs, and other public-good resources.

Requirements

The ideal candidate is an exceptional builder with the ability to drive outcomes in a fast-moving, high-stakes environment. Given the startup nature of this work, we seek contributors with high throughput, strong work ethic, and willingness to lean in and work extended hours.

You will likely have:

  • 7-10+ years' experience as a builder in international development, consulting, or an agriculture adjacent organization.
  • Experience designing and running randomized or quasi-experimental evaluations (RCTs, A/B tests, or similar) – especially to measure behavior change.
  • Track record translating evaluation results into product or program iteration, e.g. using comprehension or uptake data to redesign message content, format, or delivery channel.
  • A proven track record of significantly scaling organizations and/or programs to deliver impact at scale, preferably in close partnership with national governments.
  • Training or early career experience in a high-rigor environment (e.g., top-tier management consulting, high-growth NGO program leadership, strategy/econ research) and the ability to rapidly get up to speed in new technical areas including AI/ML forecasting concepts.
  • Demonstrated success leading international development programs from idea to scaled delivery, including managing multi-stakeholder coalitions with governments, research institutions, NGO implementers, and private sector partners.
  • A track record as a strong people manager and builder: able to set clear standards, empower others, and cultivate a high-performance culture across distributed and field-based teams.
  • High EQ and the ability to influence across diverse partners, from AI/forecasting researchers to frontline delivery staff to senior government officials.
  • Strong fluency with AI tools, and eager to experiment, learn, and adapt to emerging technologies.
  • Comfort with ambiguity and fast iteration; can define and test hypotheses, adapt quickly, and maintain focus on impact.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; able to synthesize complex technical ideas (e.g., AI/ML weather forecasting language) into crisp narratives for different audiences.
  • Willingness and ability to travel extensively internationally (~20%) to India and other low-and-middle income countries.
  • Passion for the mission of ensuring that the benefits of frontier AI reach the world's poorest populations, while mitigating its downside risks.

Position Location

This role location is flexible anywhere within the United States for fully remote candidates. Please note this role requires significant travel (~20%) to partner countries.

We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of a U.S. employment visa at this time. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the U.S. for roles based in the U.S.

Evidence Action is an Equal Opportunity Employer with a commitment to diversity. All individuals, regardless of personal characteristics, are encouraged to apply.

Benefits

The expected role range for this US position is listed below. We consider multiple factors when determining the base salary for a role, including but not limited to: role scope, program budgets, internal equity, and a candidate's qualifications and/or prior experience.

Note: Pay and benefits will be commensurate with the role specifications, local statutory requirements, and the cost of labor in the markets where we operate.

The pay range for this role is: $142,000 - $162,000 per year.

This role will initially be housed at Evidence Action, with the explicit plan to transfer with the AI Access Initiative as a founding member of the team when that project is spun out as a new entity later this year. At that point, benefits and policies may change. For US based roles, Evidence Action provides comprehensive benefits including international health care, HSA/FSA options, life insurance, disability coverage, retirement plans with a matching component, generous and flexible leave options, as well as other employee perks on a reimbursement basis. For more information visit our careers page or ask our recruiting team!

raw.excerpt: ROLE SUMMARYThe Field Medical Excellence (FME) Enterprise Systems & Enablement role is an enterprise-wide strategic role responsible for scaling customer-facing medical (CFC) technology and workflow solutions as well as digital enablement capabilities across US Oncology, US Commercial, Global, and International markets.
raw.description:
ROLE SUMMARY

The Field Medical Excellence (FME) Enterprise Systems & Enablement role is an enterprise-wide strategic role responsible for scaling customer-facing medical (CFC) technology and workflow solutions as well as digital enablement capabilities across US Oncology, US Commercial, Global, and International markets. This position drives the adoption, governance, and performance of enterprise platforms including OneMed (and its transition to Life Sciences Cloud across US and International markets), InsightXplorer, CLM (Closed Loop Marketing), Medical Scout, CFC dashboards, and KPI frameworks designed to amplify the efficiency and impact of customer-facing medical colleagues. This colleague works in collaboration with the FME (US and International), MEI and US, International, and Global medical stakeholders.

Sitting within the Field Medical Excellence function under ME&I, this colleague serves as the primary connector between FME leadership, country/field leads, MEI leadership and platform teams, brand partners, Medical Systems, and Digital to ensure enterprise solutions are fit for purpose, adopted at scale, compliant, and continuously improved. A core mandate of this role is to drive adoption of enterprise systems and enablement solutions that measurably reduce administrative burden for MSLs, FMDs, and FMOs, freeing capacity for high-value scientific exchange with HCPs and improving patient outcomes.

This position is open to US or International Pfizer colleagues with relevant experience in field medical operations, systems enablement, digital transformation, and/or enterprise technology strategy.

ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES

1.Enterprise CFC Platform Deployment & Adoption

Represent FME in the strategy, prioritization, governance, and adoption of enterprise-wide CFC systems including OneMed to Life Sciences Cloud (LSC) transition in International and US markets, InsightXplorer, CLM, Medical Scout, and FM dashboards. Serve as the FME voice in enterprise-wide steering discussions with stakeholders across US, Oncology, global and international markets.

2. OneMed / Life Sciences Cloud Transition (US & International)

Partner with digital, medical systems, MEI, country leads, and global CRM teams to plan and execute the transition from OneMed to Salesforce Life Sciences Cloud. Align data migration, user adoption, and change management strategies across US and International field medical teams as POC for FME. Ensure continuity of CFC workflows, KPI capture, and HCP engagement tracking through and beyond transition milestones. Provide ongoing Life Sciences Cloud platform support post go-live, including serving as an escalation point for content-visibility and access issues, governing the content catalog, and coordinating with content administrators to resolve tagging and configuration errors.

3. Early Pipeline & Clinical Development Support

Support enterprise systems and enablement needs for colleagues engaged in early pipeline activities, coordinating with Clinical Development to ensure CFC platforms, dashboards, and AI tools accommodate pre-launch scientific exchange, investigator and site engagement tracking, and emerging compound insight-gathering. Partner with Clinical Development stakeholders and MEI to align system requirements and data flows across the pipeline continuum, from early-phase research through launch readiness.

4. Medical Content & Communication Metrics Partnership

Coordinate with Medical Content and Communication teams to extract and interpret meaningful content performance metrics — including engagement, reach, and utilization data — that guide ongoing content strategy and development. Translate platform and dashboard insights into actionable recommendations that help content teams prioritize and refine medical materials for field and digital channels.

5. Medical Scout Program Leadership

Serve as the FME core team lead and point of contact for Medical Scout, coordinating with Medical Systems, Content & Channel Analytics, Pfizer Digital/LSC support teams, and external implementation partners on capability roadmap, data readiness, and rollout across US Oncology and US Commercial with future expansion to international markets. Oversee congress-based alerting capabilities for FM, including data validation, ticket-based enhancement requests, and SLA-driven turnaround with support teams. Partner with Medical Systems and Content & Channel Analytics to identify and resolve data pipeline and data quality issues feeding Medical Scout and represent FME in roadmap discussions and presentations to the OneMed Medical Council and Medical Ecosystem Business Council.

6. Cross-functional Stakeholder Partnership

Collaborate closely with FME Leads, country medical leads, MEI platform owners, brand teams, field teams, digital and Medical Systems to align enterprise system and AI priorities with field-level needs and organizational strategy. Build and maintain relationships with International FME leads and country coordinators to ensure global scalability of tools and processes. Represent FME interests in cross-functional steering committees, AI governance forums, and technology working groups.

7. Scalable Process Design & Change Management

Identify and close gaps in enterprise system and AI workflows through structured process improvement. Represent FME in design of scalable, repeatable implementation playbooks and SOPs for CFC tool and AI deployments that can be adapted for US Oncology, US Commercial and International markets. Represent FME in change management efforts including communication strategies, training rollouts, and feedback loops to ensure sustained adoption and field confidence.

8. Compliance, Data Integrity & Quality Assurance

Ensure all enterprise CFC systems and AI applications meet Pfizer Medical, Legal, Compliance, and Privacy requirements, including country-specific regulatory requirements for international markets. Maintain data integrity standards across platforms and AI tools, manage access controls, and support audit readiness for OneMed, CLM, AI tools, and associated data systems.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

Candidate demonstrates a breadth of diverse leadership experiences and capabilities including: the ability to influence and collaborate with peers, develop and coach others, oversee and guide the work of other colleagues to achieve meaningful outcomes and create business impact.

  • Bachelor's degree in a health science, life science, or related field required
  • PharmD, PhD, MD, or equivalent terminal doctoral degree preferred
  • 8+ years with a Bachelor's degree
  • 7+ years with a Master's degree
  • 5+ years with a PharmD, PhD, or equivalent terminal degree

Essential Experience & Competencies

  • Prior experience in a field-based medical, MSL, or FMD/FMO role strongly preferred
  • Demonstrated experience leading or supporting enterprise CRM/CFC system deployments (e.g., OneMed, Veeva CRM, LSC, or equivalent) across multiple markets or business units
  • Experience with or strong working knowledge of AI applications in a healthcare, pharmaceutical, or field medical context, including familiarity with generative AI tools, prompt-based workflows, or AI governance frameworks
  • Proven ability to work across matrixed global organizations, including cross-functional teams spanning field, brand, MEI, D&T, Legal/Compliance, and country medical leads
  • Strong analytical and data literacy skills; experience with KPI design, dashboard development, and performance reporting
  • Experience managing complex multi-stakeholder projects with competing timelines and priorities
  • Exceptional communication skills — able to translate technical, systems, and AI information for both field colleagues and senior leadership audiences
  • Demonstrated track record of driving adoption and change management for digital or technology solutions in a medical or commercial healthcare setting
  • Understanding of pharmaceutical industry compliance requirements relevant to field medical operations, including HCP engagement documentation, data privacy, AI governance, and CRM compliance
  • Ability to travel up to 30% (US and International) for field engagement, leadership meetings, and cross-market collaboration

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience with Pfizer-specific platforms and dashboards: OneMed, InsightXplorer, CLM, Compass
  • Familiarity with Salesforce Health Cloud / Life Sciences Cloud platform architecture
  • Hands-on experience deploying or governing AI tools in a regulated pharmaceutical or healthcare environment (e.g., generative AI for pre-call planning, scientific summarization, HCP profiling)

Cancer care should be more personalized, context-specific, accessible, and human.

Cancer treatment has become extraordinarily complex and precise, but care delivery remains largely episodic. Most of a patient's experience occurs between visits, when symptoms emerge, conditions change and care teams have limited visibility.
This gap is widening, not narrowing. Treatment complexity is growing faster than oncology workforce capacity, advanced therapies once confined to the hospital are increasingly monitored at home, and the cost of that gap is concrete: preventable ED visits, delayed escalation, and clinician burnout from covering more than any single care team can sustainably manage. The problem is not a lack of clinical expertise. It is a lack of infrastructure to extend that expertise continuously, to every patient, between every visit.

We believe precision treatment requires precision care: care that surrounds the patient, not just the visit.

By combining Cureety's treatment-specific symptom monitoring, longitudinal data, and clinical intelligence with Reimagine Care's AI-enabled care delivery, oncology-trained clinical operations, and 24/7 virtual care center, we can create a differentiated model of continuous oncology care.

Our ambition: become the orchestration infrastructure for precision oncology care.

About Sezzle:

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

Compensation:

For this principal development role, with 12+ years of experience, the compensation range is $12,500 - $20,800 USD based on location and experience level per month and in gross amount. This range acknowledges the extensive expertise, leadership capabilities, and significant contributions expected at this level, offering a competitive salary to reflect the value of advanced skills and experience

About the Role:

We are seeking an exceptional Principal Infrastructure Engineer to design, build, operate, and scale the platform that powers Sezzle. Your focus will be the hardest infrastructure problems: increasing throughput, reducing latency, removing capacity bottlenecks, strengthening resilience, and making production operations more automated and predictable as the business grows.

You will own complex technical initiatives from architecture and prototyping through implementation, production rollout, and ongoing operation. Your impact will come from the systems you build, the problems you solve, and measurable improvements in reliability, performance, and cost efficiency.

Our stack runs on AWS, with workloads orchestrated on Kubernetes and data anchored in Aurora RDS (MySQL and Postgres). You should know these technologies deeply and be comfortable moving between cloud architecture, networking, cluster internals, database performance, and application behavior to understand how the entire system scales. You will write code and infrastructure-as-code, debug production systems, and deliver changes that hold up under real traffic and failure conditions.

Operational ownership is part of the job. You will participate in the on-call rotation and take a hands-on role in recovering from major incidents, including full outages. We need someone who can form and test hypotheses using logs, metrics, and traces, make sound mitigation decisions with incomplete information, and turn incident findings into lasting engineering fixes.

You will also build and apply AI-assisted infrastructure and SRE tooling for incident investigation, capacity analysis, runbook automation, and toil reduction. You will evaluate these tools through practical results and apply appropriate access controls, validation, and auditability to their use in production.

This role reports to engineering leadership and works closely with application engineers, Security, and Compliance. You will develop a deep understanding of how Sezzle's business operates and how customer journeys, transaction patterns, and product decisions shape infrastructure demand and behavior. You will use that understanding to identify and deliver improvements across teams and technical domains, connecting infrastructure decisions to better customer outcomes and business performance.

What you’ll do:

  • Own the technical architecture and evolution of core infrastructure: identify system limits, prioritize technical improvements, and implement changes that support increasing traffic, data volume, and workload complexity.
  • Connect business understanding to improvements across the system: learn how key business workflows behave in production, trace their impact across applications, data, and infrastructure, and partner across teams to improve performance, reliability, and cost efficiency beyond any single service or team's scope.
  • Engineer for scale and performance: build capacity models, run load and stress tests, diagnose bottlenecks across compute, networking, Kubernetes, and databases, and validate improvements against throughput, latency, saturation, and cost per workload.
  • Design and build AWS infrastructure: implement resilient account, IAM, network, and service architectures; address service quotas, fault isolation, and multi-AZ or multi-region requirements as workloads grow.
  • Build and operate the Kubernetes platform: improve cluster architecture, lifecycle automation, workload isolation, resource allocation, autoscaling, safe upgrades, and deployment reliability.
  • Scale and optimize Aurora RDS for MySQL and Postgres: tune queries and indexes, address connection and replication bottlenecks, plan capacity, improve failover behavior, and implement safe schema changes and database migrations with application engineers.
  • Improve reliability through engineering: define and instrument service-level objectives and error budgets with service owners; implement failure isolation, backpressure, load shedding, and safe retry behavior where needed to prevent cascading failures.
  • Participate in on-call and drive technical recovery during serious incidents: use evidence-based triage, execute mitigations, communicate findings, and implement corrective actions from postmortems.
  • Implement and test disaster recovery: design backup, restore, and failover mechanisms against agreed recovery time and recovery point objectives; run recovery exercises and document measured results.
  • Build infrastructure-as-code and operational automation: make provisioning, configuration, deployments, upgrades, and recovery reproducible, reviewed, testable, and recoverable. Eliminate recurring manual work through code.
  • Build observability that makes production diagnosable: improve metrics, logs, traces, dashboards, and actionable alerts, with visibility into service health, scaling limits, and customer impact.
  • Deliver safe infrastructure migrations: design phased rollouts, compatibility checks, validation, and rollback paths for changes to shared production systems.
  • Improve cloud cost efficiency through technical changes: right-size resources, improve utilization, tune autoscaling and storage, and quantify savings while maintaining reliability and performance targets.
  • Build and evaluate AI-assisted operational tooling: apply AI to investigation, runbooks, anomaly analysis, and repetitive operations, with bounded permissions, reviewable actions, and measurable improvements in accuracy or toil.
  • Make technical decisions clear and executable: write architecture proposals, evaluate technology tradeoffs through prototypes and benchmarks, review changes affecting shared infrastructure, and document how systems operate and fail.

What We look for:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a similar technical field (required)
  • 12+ years of experience across infrastructure, platform, site reliability, software development, or related engineering disciplines, with substantial hands-on depth designing and operating production infrastructure at scale.
  • Deep expertise with AWS: production experience across compute, IAM, multi-account architectures, and networking, including VPC design and private connectivity.
  • Deep expertise with Kubernetes in production: cluster lifecycle, scheduling, resource management, autoscaling, networking, and troubleshooting business-critical workloads. EKS experience is strongly preferred.
  • Deep expertise with relational databases at scale, specifically RDS/Aurora (MySQL and/or Postgres): query performance, indexing, connection management, replication, high availability, failover, and verified backup and recovery.
  • A track record of personally delivering infrastructure scaling improvements: identifying constraints, measuring baseline behavior, implementing changes, and demonstrating gains in capacity, latency, reliability, or cost efficiency.
  • Strong coding and automation skills, using Golang, Python, or similar languages to build production tooling and eliminate operational toil, alongside infrastructure-as-code experience with Terraform or equivalent.
  • Strong systems fundamentals: Linux, networking, DNS, TLS, storage, concurrency, and distributed system failure modes, with the ability to debug problems across infrastructure and application boundaries.
  • Experience operating a 24/7, high-availability platform where downtime has direct customer or revenue impact, including hands-on incident response and postmortem remediation.
  • Willingness to participate in an on-call rotation and demonstrated ability to recover production systems under pressure using evidence-based triage, safe mitigation, and clear technical communication.
  • Experience implementing and testing disaster recovery against defined recovery objectives, including restoring data and validating service recovery.
  • Practical experience with observability, load testing, capacity planning, and safe CI/CD practices for shared production infrastructure.
  • Active use of AI tooling in engineering or operations, with practical judgment about its limitations and how to verify generated code, recommendations, and operational actions.
  • Ability to carry ambiguous technical problems from investigation through production delivery and collaborate across engineering disciplines to resolve system-wide constraints.

Preferred Knowledge and Skills:

  • Experience in fintech, payments, or banking, operating infrastructure with demanding reliability, security, and audit requirements.
  • Experience with multi-region architectures, chaos engineering, and failure testing, including the consistency and recovery tradeoffs of distributed data systems.
  • Proficiency with Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Tempo, or comparable observability systems.
  • Experience building internal platform capabilities and self-service tooling, including deployment automation, progressive delivery, and reusable infrastructure components.
  • Experience building AI-assisted incident investigation or operational automation with restricted access, auditable execution, and clear human review points

About You:

  • You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.
  • You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things
  • You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.
  • You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.
  • You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.
  • You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.
  • You go deep: you investigate how systems behave under load and failure, follow the evidence, and fix underlying causes.
  • You build and ship: you turn architecture into working code, tested infrastructure, and safe production changes.
  • You measure results: you can explain the impact of your work in availability, latency, capacity, recovery time, cost, or hours of toil removed.
  • You value simplicity: you choose systems that are understandable, operable, and appropriate to the problem, and reduce unnecessary complexity.
  • You earn trust: you listen carefully, communicate clearly, challenge technical decisions respectfully, and follow through on commitments.
  • You stay accountable for the outcome: you verify that changes work in production and that fixes remain effective as the platform scales.

Sezzle’s Technology Stack:

  • Languages: Golang, Python
  • Database: MySQL, Postgres
  • DevOps and Cloud: AWS, Kubernetes
  • Version Control: Git
  • CI/CD: Gitlab
  • Open Source: Sezzle is focused on using open source, and we build what we can before buying!

What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome?

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators; we are skilled musicians, yogis, cyclists, chefs, golfers, dog-lovers, and rock-climbers. We believe in surrounding ourselves with not only the best and the brightest individuals, but those that are unique and purpose-driven in all that they do. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

raw.description:
Our Story

TopDog Law is not your typical law firm. We're a nationally scaling personal injury firm built for impact and growth — owning the client experience end-to-end, from marketing and intake through litigation. We believe that world-class marketing, paired with exceptional legal talent and operations, creates better experiences and outcomes for clients and the business alike.

Over the past three years, we've grown 2–3x year over year, setting a new standard on the marketing side of the personal injury space and proving what's possible when strategy, speed, and execution align. Now we're applying that same discipline and innovation to firm operations, case management, and national scale — intentionally building the infrastructure, systems, and teams to grow without sacrificing quality, culture, or accountability.

We are a fully remote team that share trust, open communication, and a commitment to doing great work. If you love ownership, thrive in a fast-moving environment, and want to help build something exceptional, you'll feel right at home here.

The Opportunity

The Case Manager Lead is responsible for the day-to-day supervision, coordination, and execution of the pre-litigation case management team within the pod. This role ensures cases are properly investigated, documented, and progressed toward demand preparation and settlement.

The Case Manager Lead acts as the operational leader for the case manager team, ensuring case managers execute consistently, maintain organized files, and follow firm workflows and documentation standards. This role partners closely with the Pre-Litigation Attorney, who provides legal direction and strategy for cases.

What You Will Own

1. Case Manager Team Supervision

  • Supervise 3–5 Pre-Litigation Case Managers within the pod
  • Assign and balance workloads across the team
  • Provide guidance on case handling procedures and documentation standards
  • Ensure case managers understand priorities and case progression expectations
  • Provide coaching and day-to-day support to help case managers execute effectively
  • Serve as the primary operational liaison between the case manager team and the Pre-Litigation Attorney
  • Handle escalations from clients and providers, resolving issues before they reach the attorney or Ops Manager
  • Escalate friction points between case managers and the attorney to the Pre-Lit Case Manager Ops Manager

2. Medical Management & Case Value Ownership

  • Own MRI rates, advanced treatment rates, and ensure diagnostics are properly tracked and attended
  • Monitor and drive case velocity — ensuring cases move efficiently through each pre-litigation phase
  • Ensure settlements meet expected value targets relative to policy limits
  • Identify roadblocks to case progression and proactively clear them
  • Flag systemic medical management issues to the Pre-Lit Case Manager Ops Manager

3. Case Investigation & Documentation Oversight

  • Monitor progress of medical record collection and documentation gathering
  • Ensure case files contain required documentation and supporting evidence
  • Confirm liability and damages documentation is organized and complete
  • Review case files for completeness prior to escalation to the attorney
  • Maintain strong case file organization and documentation discipline

4. Data, Reporting & Process Improvement

  • Actively use dashboards and reporting tools to evaluate team KPIs and identify underperformance
  • Identify process changes and efficiency improvements through direct case experience and data analysis
  • Surface operational gaps and improvement ideas to the Pre-Lit Case Manager Ops Manager
  • Be comfortable building or pulling reports independently — data literacy is a core expectation of this role, not optional

5. Team Support & Development

  • Lead onboarding and training for new case managers joining the pod
  • Provide informal coaching and identify skill gaps requiring additional training
  • Promote consistency in case handling practices and ownership mentality across the team
  • Model best practices in case management, documentation, client communication, and ownership through personal caseload performance

6. Personal Caseload Management

  • Manage approximately 50 active pre-litigation cases, with an emphasis on higher-value matters
  • Be held to a higher performance standard than case managers given the complexity and value of the assigned caseload
  • Balance personal case execution responsibilities alongside team supervision duties
  • Demonstrate full ownership over cases — regardless of what other departments (medical records, CV specialists, settlement, etc.) have or haven't done, the Case Manager Lead is accountable for outcomes on their cases
  • Identify workflow challenges or process gaps through direct case experience and escalate operational improvements when needed

What You Bring

Required:

  • 6-8 years of experience supporting Personal Injury pre-litigation matters on cases in multiple states or the state of Tennessee
  • Proven experience managing and leading a team of case managers, directing case strategy and workflow to efficiently drive files through each phase and toward timely settlement
  • Strong organizational skills with exceptional attention to detail
  • Ability to manage a high-volume caseload in a fast-paced environment
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Experience requesting, reviewing, and summarizing medical records and bills
  • Ability to prioritize tasks, meet deadlines, and work independently while collaborating with a team

Preferred (Nice to Have):

  • Bachelor’s degree or Paralegal Certificate (not required)
  • Proven experience managing and developing a team within a legal environment
  • Experience in high-volume or fast-growing law firms
  • Familiarity with Personal Injury claims processes and insurance procedures
  • Experience with case management software (e.g., Filevine, Clio, SmartAdvocate)
  • Comfort working in evolving systems and processes

Who Thrives Here (Core Values)

We don't hire on resumes alone. We hire for competence, character, and mindset.

  • Embrace Change: Open to feedback, embracing change, and always asking "what's next?"
  • Committed: You care deeply, have your teammates' backs, and show up to build something lasting.
  • No-Ego Energy: Positive, professional, and solutions-oriented. Drama stays at the door.
  • Ownership: You do what you say, follow through, and treat the business like it's yours.
  • Fast & Hungry: You move with urgency, thrive under high expectations, and are motivated by growth and impact.

What We Offer

  • Base Salary: $79,200 to $112,600 per year, commensurate with experience (Remote, Tennessee)
  • Our job postings reflect the compensation range for the specific market and location of each role. Ranges vary by geography based on local market rates and cost of labor.
  • Benefits include: Medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) with company match, HSA, life insurance, disability coverage, paid time off, and parental leave.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Job Description

Join Us as a (Senior) Clinical Research Associate in our client dedicated FSP team - Belgium – Make an Impact at the Forefront of Innovation

We have successfully supported the top 50 pharmaceutical companies and more than 750 biotechs, spanning 2,700 clinical trials across 100+ countries in the last 5 years.

As part of our global team, you’ll have the opportunity to perform and coordinate all aspects of the clinical monitoring and site management process. As a Senior Clinical Research Associate (Level I), you'll conduct remote or on-site visits to assess protocol and regulatory compliance and manage required documentation. You will manage procedures and guidelines from different sponsors and/or monitoring environments (i.e., FSO, FSP, Government, etc.). Acting as a site processes specialist, you will ensure that the trial is conducted in accordance with the approved protocol, ICH-GCP guidelines, applicable regulations, and SOPs to guarantee subjects' rights, well-being, and data reliability. You will ensure audit readiness and develop collaborative relationships with investigational sites. Detailed tasks and responsibilities assigned to your role are outlined in the task matrix.

We are seeking a (Senior) Clinical Research Associate to join our client dedicated FSP team - Belgium. The position can be fully remote in Belgium or hybrid/office based from our site in Brussels.

We do require previous independent monitoring CRA experience and fluency in Dutch, English and French.

What You’ll Do:

  • Monitors investigator sites with a risk-based monitoring approach: applies root cause analysis (RCA), critical thinking and problem-solving skills to identify site processes failure and corrective/preventive actions to bring the site into compliance and decrease risks. Ensures data accuracy through SDR, SDV and CRF review as applicable through on-site and remote monitoring activities. Assess investigational product through physical inventory and records review. Documents observations in reports and letters in a timely manner using approved business writing standards. Escalates observed deficiencies and issues to clinical management expeditiously and follow all issues through to resolution. May need to maintain regular contact between monitoring visits with investigative sites to confirm that the protocol is being followed, that previously identified issues are being resolved and that the data is being recorded in a timely manner. Conducts monitoring tasks in accordance with the approved monitoring plan. Participates in the investigator payment process. Ensures a shared responsibility with other project team members on issues/findings resolution. Investigates and follows-up on findings as applicable

  • Provides trial status tracking and progress update reports to the Clinical Team Manager (CTM) as required. Ensures study systems are updated per agreed study conventions (e.g. Clinical Trial Management System, CTMS). Performs QC check of reports generated from CTMS system where required.

  • Participates in investigator meetings as necessary. Identifies potential investigators in collaboration with the client company to ensure the acceptability of qualified investigative sites. Initiates clinical trial sites according to the relevant procedures to ensure compliance with the protocol and regulatory and ICH GCP obligations, making recommendations where warranted. Ensures trial close out and retrieval of trial materials.

  • Ensures that required essential documents are complete and in place, according to ICH-GCP and applicable regulations. Conducts on-site file reviews as per project specifications.

  • Contributes to the project team by assisting in preparation of project publications/tools, and sharing ideas/suggestions with team members. Performs additional study tasks as assigned by CTM (e.g. trip report review, newsletter creation, lead CRA team calls etc).

  • Facilitates effective communication between investigative sites, the client company and the PPD project team through written, oral and/or electronic contacts.

  • Responds to company, client and applicable regulatory requirements/audits/inspections.

  • Maintains & completes administrative tasks such as expense reports and timesheets in a timely manner.

  • Contributes to other project work and initiatives for process improvement, as required.

Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor's degree in a life sciences related field or a Registered Nursing certification or equivalent and relevant formal academic / vocational qualification.

  • Previous experience that provides the knowledge, skills, and abilities to perform the job (comparable to 2+ years as a clinical research monitor).

  • Valid full driver's licence

​In some cases an equivalency, consisting of a combination of appropriate education, training and/or directly related experience, will be considered sufficient for an individual to meet the requirements of the role.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:

  • Effective clinical monitoring skills

  • Demonstrated understanding of medical/therapeutic area knowledge and medical terminology

  • Excellent understanding and demonstrated application of ICH GCPs, applicable regulations and procedural documents

  • Well-developed critical thinking skills, including but not limited to critical mindset, in-depth investigation for appropriate root cause analysis and problem solving

  • Ability to manages Risk Based Monitoring concepts and processes

  • Effective oral and written communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with medical personnel

  • Ability to maintain customer focus through the utilization of good listening skills, attention to detail and the ability to perceive customers’ underlying issues

  • Effective interpersonal skills

  • Strong attention to detail

  • Effective organizational and time management skills

  • Ability to remain flexible and adaptable in a wide range of scenarios

  • Ability to work in a team or independently as required

  • Good computer skills: proficient knowledge of Microsoft Office and the ability to learn appropriate software

  • Good Dutch, French and English language and grammar skills

  • Good presentation skills


Working Conditions and Environment:

  • Working Conditions and Environment:

  • Work is performed in an office/ laboratory/clinical/and/or home office environment with exposure to electrical office equipment.

  • Frequent drives to site locations. Frequent travel, generally 60-80% but more for some individuals.

  • May also include extended overnight stays.

  • Exposure to biological fluids with potential exposure to infectious organisms.

  • Exposure to fluctuating and/or extreme temperatures on rare occasions.

  • Must be able to comply with specific sponsor/client/site requirements, even if not required by Thermo Fisher Scientific (e.g., disclosure of vaccination status, or other personal information). On some occasions, this information may be required to be provided directly t team members on issues/findings resolution. Investigates and follows-up on findings as applicable

raw.description:
About Hello Heart:

Hello Heart is on a mission to make heart attacks a thing of the past.

We’re an AI company focused exclusively on heart health, building a platform that predicts and prevents cardiac events before they happen—identifying risk up to 10 days in advance versus 10 years in traditional clinical models.

This is already working at scale. Hello Heart has been shown to reduce inpatient hospital days by 47% and deliver ~$1,800 in annual savings per member. Hello Heart is the cardiac prevention partner to over 80% of large U.S. health plans and serves hundreds of public and private employers.

We’re defining how the #1 cause of death—heart disease—is managed in the AI era. Join us.

About the role:

Hello Heart is growing, and we are looking for a Tier 3 Support Engineer to join our dynamic team. In this role, you will be responsible for investigating and resolving complex technical issues, backend services, and serving as a trusted technical partner for our internal teams. This role is a strong fit for someone who is curious, technically sharp, collaborative, and motivated by meaningful work.

Reporting to our Director of Technical Operations, you'll work across three core areas: investigating technical user issues, supporting client integrations, and diving into data (analysis, troubleshooting, and transformation). This role is not user or client facing.

Responsibilities:

  • Triage, investigate, and resolve production-related issues across backend services, data workflows, and technical support systems
  • Support bug fixes and technical investigations through scripting, database queries, and backend data analysis
  • Troubleshoot application logs (AWS/Kibana) to identify root causes, patterns, and paths to resolution
  • Configure and troubleshoot JSON/YAML files to support issue resolution and system updates
  • Retrieve, analyze, and validate user data using SQL and MongoDB to support investigations, reporting, and internal requests
  • Partner with Engineering, Client Operations, User Support, and other internal teams to escalate issues, improve workflows, and reduce recurring support friction

Qualifications:

  • Must be located in CST or EST time zone
    • Expected working hours: Monday - Friday / 8 AM - 5 PM EST
  • 3+ years of experience handling Tier 3 technical support requests in high growth environment
  • Ability to read, understand, and troubleshoot code (Python, SQL, Scala, etc)
  • Ability to troubleshoot and configure JSON/YAML files
  • Proven hands-on experience working with AWS ecosystem (S3, SQS, Athena)
  • Proven hands-on experience working with MongoDB and SQL-based database management system
  • Working knowledge of Kubernetes fundamentals (pods, deployments, services)
  • Excellent written/verbal communication and documentation skills, with the ability to communicate clearly across departments and varying levels of technical literacy
  • Experienced using artificial intelligence tools or agents in your daily workflow to accelerate technical investigation, summarize findings, improve documentation, and delegate repeatable tasks

The US base salary range for this full-time position is $90,000.00 to $110,000.00. Salary ranges are determined by role and level. Compensation is determined by additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Please note that the compensation details listed in US role postings reflect the annual salary and bonus only, and do not include equity or benefits.

Hello Heart has a positive, diverse, and supportive culture - we look for people who are collaborative, creative, and courageous. Oh, and if you want to see some recent evidence of the fun things we do at Hello Heart, check out our Instagram page.

raw.description:
Location: Remote-Anywhere in LATAM

Job Type: Full-time - Contractor

Compensation: USD

Nivel avanzado de Inglés y Español

We’re hiring a Social Media Strategist & AI-Enabled Short-Form Content Producer to help scale the content engine behind GBS Group and our startup brand, LLC Hub. This role owns the strategy, creation, distribution, and optimization of short-form content across Instagram Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, and LinkedIn.

This is not an editing role or a content creation role. We are looking for a marketer with strong content fundamentals who actively uses AI tools to improve research, ideation, scripting, production, analysis, and workflow efficiency. You will combine and coordinate creative execution with sound marketing judgment to turn complex financial and business advice into engaging, accurate, and useful content.

You will work inside the Shared Services team and report to the Marketing Manager. You will collaborate closely with our management team and subject-matter experts to create content that builds trust, increases awareness, and supports demand generation among business owners and entrepreneurs. You will coordinate with Influencers and Agencies in the creation of content as well.

Responsibilities

Content Creation

  • Produce 2 to 3 short-form videos and graphics per day for GBS Group’s channels, balancing quality, speed, and strategic purpose.
  • Video Scripting: Researching, developing, and writing engaging, audience-focused scripts for content creators (e.g., Instagram Reels, TikToks, YouTube Shorts).
  • Use AI tools to accelerate research, ideation, first-draft scripting, captions, transcription, repurposing, visual concepts, and editing workflows—while applying human judgment to protect accuracy, brand voice, and quality.
  • Coordinate the editing of engaging clips tailored to Reels, TikTok, and Shorts by repurposing long-form advisory content or editing raw footage provided by leadership.
  • Translate complex tax, accounting, and business growth concepts into simple, visual, highly shareable content that provides value to entrepreneurs and business owners.
  • Coordinate the design of on-brand visuals for video overlays, carousels, and thumbnails using Canva or Adobe Creative Suite.
  • Coordinate the creation and maintain repeatable templates, prompt libraries, and production workflows that improve creative output and turnaround time.

Platform Strategy and Publishing

  • Plan, schedule, and publish content across Instagram, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, and LinkedIn.
  • Maintain a balanced content mix:
    • Educational: Tax tips, compliance reminders, financial literacy.
    • Inspirational: "Building a business worth owning," entrepreneurship mindset.
    • Service-Focused: highlighting GBS capabilities and client success stories.
  • Monitor platform trends, audience behavior, client FAQs, and industry news; apply relevant opportunities to a professional B2B context.
  • Use audience insight, performance data, and marketing priorities to test new content formats, hooks, series, calls to action, and distribution approaches.

Performance and Optimization

  • Review performance metrics weekly (Views, Retention, Engagement, Inbound Leads) and provide clear insights and recommendations.
  • Track KPIs specifically related to brand awareness and MQLs (Marketing Qualified Leads).
  • Use AI-supported analysis and strong marketing judgment to identify patterns, content opportunities, and areas for improvement.
  • Suggest experiments or new formats to increase reach among our ideal clients: business owners with $1M+ revenue and Hispanic entrepreneurs looking to register an LLC in the US.
  • Document learnings from content tests and translate them into actionable improvements for future content.

Collaboration and Workflow

  • Partner with the Marketing Manager to align on creative direction, audience priorities, campaign objectives, and upcoming launches.
  • Contribute 10–15 new Content ideas each week based on client FAQs, performance insights, social trends, existing blogs and industry news.
  • Maintain clean systems and documentation in HubSpot, Basecamp and Google Drive.
  • Manage the pipeline of incoming raw footage from leadership to ensure a steady stream of content.
  • Communicate clearly with subject matter experts to ensure content is accurate, useful, and aligned with GBS and LLC Hub’s positioning.

Requirements

  • Experience: 3+ years creating high-performing short-form content for business, educational, or professional brands.
  • Portfolio: Demonstrating strong editing, design, creative execution, and marketing thinking. Please include links to TikToks/Reels you have created and, when possible, the objective or results behind the work.
  • Technical Expertise:
    • Short-form editing (Premiere Pro, CapCut, or Final Cut).
    • Graphic design for social (Canva or Photoshop).
    • Proven, hands-on use of AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, CapCut AI, Descript, Leonardo AI, Midjourney) to improve marketing research, content ideation, scripting, asset creation, editing, repurposing, analysis, or workflow automation.
    • Understanding of when AI output requires fact-checking, editing, brand judgment, or subject matter expert review.
  • Soft Skills:
    • Kind Candor: Ability to give and receive direct feedback to improve creative output.
    • Pursue Growth and Learning: Willingness to learn the basics of our industry (tax/accounting) to create accurate content.
    • Find Solutions: Ability to operate quickly and solve creative problems without constant supervision.
  • Organization: Highly organized with strong attention to detail, file management, version control, and content workflow management.

Results (Success Metrics)

  • Consistency: Consistently deliver 2 to 3 high-quality short-form assets per day that meet brand standards and support marketing priorities.
  • Growth: Grow reach and engagement across all platforms, specifically targeting our ideal client profile.
  • Systemization: Maintain an organized content calendar and AI-enabled workflow that provides clear visibility and improves efficiency for the wider team.
  • Ideation: Generate a steady stream of fresh content ideas aligned with GBS priorities (e.g., Tax Season, New Startup Regulations).
  • Brand Alignment: Ensure all content reflects our mission to help entrepreneurs achieve their financial goals, maintains factual accuracy, and strengthens brand trust.
  • Optimization: Use performance insights and structured experiments to improve content quality, reach, retention, engagement, and contribution to MQL generation.

Culture Fit

At GBS Group, we value:

  • Client First: Content should always provide value to the viewer.
  • Find Solutions and Create Simplicity: We make the complex world of tax and business simple for our audience.
  • Help Build an Extraordinary Workplace: We share information openly and support one another.
Salary: USD

About Diana Health: Diana Health is a high-growth network of modern women's health practices on a mission to set a new standard of care that inspires, empowers, and supports women to live healthier, more fulfilling lives. We partner directly with hospitals using integrated care teams, smart technology, and a thoughtfully designed care experience that is good for patients and good for providers. The result is an individualized, comprehensive care program that puts women in the driver's seat of their own health.

We are an interdisciplinary team joined together by a shared commitment to transforming women's health.

Come join us!

Role Description:

We're looking for a Fractional Clinical Recruiter who genuinely loves the human side of hiring. You're the kind of recruiter who remembers the details, follows up because you actually care, and takes real pride in making candidates feel seen throughout the process — not just moved through a pipeline.

In this role, you'll own the full recruitment life cycle for Advanced Practice Provider positions across our multi-state practices, connecting talented CNMs, WHNPs, and other APPs with clinical teams that are doing truly meaningful work for women and families. You'll be a key part of a small, collaborative recruiting team where your contributions are visible, valued, and directly tied to patient impact.

What You'll Do:

  • Own the end-to-end recruiting process for Advanced Practice Provider roles, including:
    • Sourcing passive candidates through platforms like Indeed, LinkedIn, ACNM, and other specialty talent resources, as well as generating referrals
    • Reviewing resumes and initiating thoughtful, personalized outreach to prospective candidates
    • Conducting in-depth initial interviews to assess fit for each site's specific needs
    • Coordinating interviews across multiple stakeholders
    • Building and nurturing candidate pipelines for current and future openings
  • Maintain consistent, proactive communication with candidates throughout the hiring process; escalate questions or concerns to hiring managers and leadership as appropriate
  • Deliver routine and ad hoc hiring status reports and pipeline updates to the Clinical Recruitment Manager
  • Perform other duties as required or assigned that are reasonably within the scope of this role

Experience / Qualifications:

  • A minimum of 1 year of dedicated women's health recruiting experience is REQUIRED
  • Experience recruiting Certified Nurse Midwives (CNMs) and Women's Health Nurse Practitioners (WHNPs) strongly preferred; familiarity with CNM/WHNP scope of practice, credentialing requirements, and compensation benchmarks is a significant plus
  • Demonstrated proficiency with ATS and CRM tools; Greenhouse experience a plus
  • Experience with Google Suite
  • Experience Sourcing passive candidates using multiple hiring tools
  • Excellent communication and negotiation skills with a warm, relationship-driven approach
  • Ability to manage multiple searches simultaneously in a fast-paced, remote environment
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills; able to present information clearly to candidates, hiring managers, and clinical leaders
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently and thrive in a remote setting

Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation

Diana Health Culture:

  • Growth mindset — continuous learning and improvement are in our DNA
  • Positive, can-do, "how can I help?" attitude
  • Deep empathy for our team, our candidates, and our patients
  • Ownership mentality — we drive to results

Become a part of our caring community

The Associate Actuary, Pricing is responsible for setting pricing assumptions to support Medicare Part D bids. You will provide guidance to Product Development on new product/benefit cost impacts. You will develop and maintain pricing tools that price standard and custom benefits.

The Associate Actuary, Pricing develops and maintains projections of drug utilization trends for Humana's Medicare Part D products to support pricing, forecasting, bid development, and strategic decision-making.

  • Analyzes historical claims experience, emerging utilization patterns, member behavior, and market dynamics to identify key drivers of pharmacy cost trends and forecast future utilization at the drug, therapeutic class, and product levels.
  • Leverages actuarial models, experience studies, and analytical tools to research root causes of utilization changes and capture actionable insights.
  • Collaborates with pricing, forecasting, clinical, pharmacy, formulary, and finance teams to ensure utilization assumptions appropriately reflect emerging experience, operational initiatives, and industry developments.
  • Monitors external factors, including new drug launches, loss of exclusivity events, clinical guideline changes, and regulatory impacts, to assess their influence on future utilization patterns.
  • Communicates findings and recommendations to business partners and leadership, supporting sound forecasting and strategic planning decisions.
  • Begins to influence department strategy through subject matter expertise in Medicare Part D utilization trends.


Use your skills to make an impact

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree
  • Associate of Society of Actuaries (ASA) designation
  • MAAA
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills including the ability to translate complex topics to both technical and non-technical audiences
  • Strong analytical skills

  • Three or more years of Pricing, Medicare and/or Part D experience
  • SAS/SQL/R/Databricks programming experience
  • Experience with Power BI dashboards
